title: A case of printed beams: a Raspberry Pi 4 case with no bar to buy
summary: A small case of 2020 beams drawn in aluminium, every beam found printable in PETG, then drawn printed: posts and rails standing up from MISUMI's section, the cross beam lying down from the kit's printable profile, printed brackets, gussets, panels' clips, feet, the board's mount and a fan mount, all on one plate of 73 parts that prints clean. The sag under the board both ways. Predictions only so far: nothing has been printed
